correctness.rationale: The two-update event equals \(\mathbb E[e^{\sum_i X_i}]\), yielding the transfer matrix with exact trace and determinant and positive eigenvalues. Strict splitting and convexity prove extremal cycle partitions. Polynomial peeling proves reconstruction. A standalone exact rational checker passes 12767 assertions and checks the n=8 values. Limits: finite tests are not an infinite proof; the general proof is explicit in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: An exact all-n structural criterion for earliest topology-sensitive extinction risk in a standard ecological occupancy model. It completely orders cycle partitions, sharpens the effect of reciprocity while keeping it fixed, separates networks with identical coarse graph summaries, and establishes interval-response structural identifiability. These extend beyond a single transfer calculation and connect directly to the network-persistence questions in the cited literature. Real-world and longer-horizon conclusions are not claimed.
